instruction: Disable all new email sound notifications in Thunderbird to help me minimize distractions while working.

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling new mail sound notifications in Thunderbird. The evaluator checks that the mail.biff.play_sound preference is set to false, which disables audio alerts when new mail arrives. This is a common Thunderbird setting for users who prefer silent notifications.
